sentences.text: Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant Lok Bahadur Chand seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No.101 of 2019 dated 07.05.2019,
under Section 376, 506 Ipc, Police Station Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, the applicant and the victim, both came close to each other through some social media platform.
They started talking to each other.

On 17.05.2016, for the first time, they both met physically when the FIR records that the applicant spiked the drink of the victim and established physical relations with her and also took some obscene photographs.
Thereafter, the applicant continued establishing physical relations with the victim.
The FIR also records that the applicant had also proposed the victim.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant and the victim, both were major; their relationship was consensual; both have separately been married now; they have filed a compounding application in the court; it is still pending being C-482 No.2099 of 2022.

It is argued that the trial has yet not started; summons were served on the father of the applicant and the bailable warrants have been issued against the applicant.
5. State to file objections.

sentences.text: Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iii) He shall deposit his passport with the court concerned.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect.
(iv) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i) & (ii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 14.03.2024
